gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Admission depends on tentative acceptance from an advisor; supervisor support is part of the application.
supervisor.quote: Qualification for admission to the civil engineering graduate program is contingent on first receiving tentative acceptance from an academic advisor who will accept you into their research group.

funding.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

entry_route.value: A master's degree in engineering is normally required; strong master's students may transfer without a thesis.
entry_route.quote: To qualify for admission to the PhD in Civil Engineering program, you must normally have completed a master's-level degree in Engineering.
